note: Hand-written inputs for docs/WORKERS.md section 4. Inputs are already-normalized text, because that is what the pipeline feeds in. The cases pin the tokenizer (CJK bigrams, run splitting, punctuation trimming), the shingle rule, and the FNV-1a/SimHash integers - the part of the contract where 'byte-identical across languages' is achievable rather than aspirational.

cases.note: fewer than three tokens: the whole token list is the one shingle, and the simhash equals the token's own hash
no tokens, no shingles, all-zero hash
tokens that are nothing but punctuation emit nothing
the same shingle twice keeps the hash stable

input.text: a b c a b c

cases.note: edge punctuation is trimmed, so this matches 'hello world'
a two-character CJK run emits one bigram, per token
a three-character run emits two overlapping bigrams
a run of one emits the character itself
one token with a latin run, a CJK run and a latin run
kana and Hangul are CJK runs too
the shape of a real feed title: CJK brackets, a full-width prefix, latin words

input.text: 【3d披露】新衣装お披露目 live now

cases.note: over 300 tokens, to catch accumulator bugs that only show on longer input

input.text: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog while the diligent vtuber monitor watches every source it was told to watch and writes a dated report about everything it saw and everything it could not see because the network refused to cooperate again today

cases.note: digits are tokens, a lone punctuation token is not
